1.title: Why Bigger Context Windows Won't Save Your Agent — Elizabeth Fuentes Leone, AWS
1.author: AI Engineer
1.hook: Four concrete strategies (externalize, select, compress, isolate) for keeping agent context windows effective when tools return huge data, with code examples in Strands Agents framework.

1.title: Giving AI Agents Memory That Learns — Jake Broekhuizen, LangChain
1.author: AI Engineer
1.hook: Walk through how to turn agent traces into durable memory that changes behavior — semantic/episodic/procedural types, read-write cycle, and three hard lessons (what to keep, caching, human review).

2.title: Let Anyone at Your Company Ship Internal Apps with AI — Garrett Galow, WorkOS
2.author: AI Engineer
2.hook: WorkOS built a CLI + platform (Atlas) that lets non-engineers ship internal AI apps securely; 37% of 278 apps in production were built without engineers, handling 3M+ requests/week.

3.title: Why We Deleted Our MCP Server and Rebuilt It — Abhi Arya, Reducto
3.author: AI Engineer
3.hook: Product leader at Reducto deleted a one-tool-per-endpoint MCP server after it broke in production, then rebuilt with fewer, semantically meaningful tools plus confidence scoring and self-improving instrumentation.

4.title: How Jeetu Patel Runs Cisco Like the World’s Largest Startup
4.author: Y Combinator
4.hook: Cisco's hyperscaler AI business hit $9.3B in orders in two years; Patel discusses how he's running a 32K-engineer company like a startup and what infrastructure AI agents actually need.

1.title: Turning Agent Memory Into Skills That Work — Will Lyon, Neo4j
1.author: AI Engineer
1.hook: Agent memory as typed execution graphs with grounding checks and skill distillation — moves beyond retrieval to actionable, governed knowledge that multiple agents can learn from.

2.title: We Mapped 115 Microservices for Our Coding Agents — Kamalakannan Nandagopal, Postman
2.author: AI Engineer
2.hook: Staff engineer at Postman built an API context graph mapping 115 microservices and thousands of endpoints to ground coding agents in real distributed systems, with evals showing 75% of PRs touch APIs and a 21-page architecture review generated autonomously.

3.title: Your AI Agent Has No Nervous System — Matt Gibiec, Dynatrace
3.author: AI Engineer
3.hook: AI agents need observability ("nervous system") to see production dependencies and avoid loops—Bluebox brings real environment context into agent decisions before they ship.
